AnswerSettings.description:
What the base gives back to an agent's turn: an answer with citations or the pieces alone, whether an answer
citing none of its pieces is withheld, and what is said when nothing is found. The model, temperature, length and
instructions are the agent's.
AnswerSettings.title: AnswerSettings

ChangeCitation.description: A workflow whose runs cited the changed passage; nothing records citations yet, so the list is empty.
ChangeCitation.title: ChangeCitation

DuplicateCopy.description: The item a duplicate repeats, named as the caller knows it.
DuplicateCopy.title: DuplicateCopy

EventIn.description: A service event, as documents-service's relay sends it: the tenant and team come from the token.
EventIn.title: EventIn

ItemRevision.description: An edit to the document; nothing records edits yet, so the list is empty.
ItemRevision.title: ItemRevision

ItemText.description:
What was read from an item's file, section by section after the source's cleaning, with each block's place on
its page, for the document view beside the original. `status` is done, reading (documents-service has not
finished), or none (the item has no file, or no reading can be had now); `notes` say in plain words what was not
read or could not be shown.
ItemText.title: ItemText

ItemUnit.description: What search matches for a piece: its own text (`self`), a child, or a question written for it.
ItemUnit.title: ItemUnit

KbAccess.description: What the console shows of who may search a base: the stored MCP offer beside the fixed facts of the team.
KbAccess.title: KbAccess

Option.description:
One choice in a picker: what it stores, what it shows, a short hint, and why it cannot be chosen when it
cannot (the agent lacks a tool the widget needs, say).
Option.title: Option

OptionsPage.description:
A page of a picker's choices, searched and limited in the store query. `next_cursor` asks for the next page;
None at the end. Every `/options` route answers this, and `ids=` resolves stored values to their labels.
OptionsPage.title: OptionsPage

PlaygroundChunk.description: A piece the search found, with each lane's score.
PlaygroundChunk.title: PlaygroundChunk

PlaygroundCitation.description: A passage the answer cites, numbered as the answer cites it.
PlaygroundCitation.title: PlaygroundCitation

PrecedenceRule.description: A rule choosing between two returned pieces on one topic; the index applies one: a newer version wins.
PrecedenceRule.title: PrecedenceRule

ReadingPage.description:
One page of the stored reading: how it was read, its blocks by kind after cleaning, and what cleaning removed.
Number and reader are documents-service's, passed on as it sent them.
ReadingPage.title: ReadingPage

RerankOut.description: Present when a base reranks: whether it ran, on which alias, how many pieces it scored, or why it was skipped.
RerankOut.title: RerankOut

RetrievalSettings.description: How a search of the base runs (retrieval.py) and which of its pieces it may return.
RetrievalSettings.title: RetrievalSettings

RewriteOut.description: The question as asked and as searched, present when a base rewrites questions.
RewriteOut.title: RewriteOut

RunError.description:
One failure a run recorded: the step (list, get, store or parse), its class and message, and the item when one
was reached (a listing failure names none; an app's item may have no title).
RunError.title: RunError

RunPhase.description: One step of a run as the console draws it; no run records its steps yet, so the list is empty.
RunPhase.title: RunPhase

ScopesIn.description:
What a person searches for while picking what a plugin source takes in: sites or spaces by name, or, with
`parent`, what one picked site holds (its libraries).
ScopesIn.title: ScopesIn

SourceDefaults.description:
How a new source of the base splits its documents; each source keeps its own copy, changed on the source. AI
steps are refused here: they need an estimate and an approval per source.
SourceDefaults.title: SourceDefaults

SyncIn.description:
The console's SyncOptions. Unknown fields are refused rather than ignored, so a caller never believes an option
it sent was honoured.
SyncIn.title: SyncIn

SyncSettings.description:
How the syncs of the base's sources treat what they find: a changed version applied at once or held in Changes
for review, an item removed at its source taken out of search or kept and flagged, when an item is stale, and
whether the owner is told when a sync keeps failing.
SyncSettings.title: SyncSettings

TextBox.description: Where a block sits on its page, as fractions of the page from its top left (documents-service's boxes).
TextBox.title: TextBox

ToolSourceConfig.description:
What an app's source keeps of its settings for the screen: the plugin and source it reads, its tools and
connection, and the values it was set up with.
ToolSourceConfig.title: ToolSourceConfig

WrittenItemIn.description:
One item written into a typed text or push source. `name` is its key: sent again with the same content it is
unchanged, with new content it is the item's next version.
WrittenItemIn.title: WrittenItemIn
